title: Rabbi Elazar bar Merom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:2 he raised an objection against Rav Chuna’s words. In Taanit 4:3 the statement appears with his raising an objection before Rabbi Yonah. Hyman cites Ruth Rabbah 4:9 for “Rabbi Elazar bar Miriam said.” He gives the name Rabbi Elazar bar Maron at the beginning of chapter 7 of Shir HaShirim Rabbah. Hyman suggests that perhaps they are one.

notes.text: אר״א is rendered “Rabbi Elazar said,” after the heading.

Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:3 explicitly places the objection before Rabbi Yonah. The consulted Song of Songs Rabbah reads Elazar bar Rabbi Maron. The cited Ruth Rabbah 4:9 in the consulted edition concerns Ruth 2:9 and does not contain the cited name.
